descriptions: A ragged opening in the cliff, half-drowned at high tide. Cold air breathes out of it, smelling of salt and old stone.
features: A rusted mooring ring, worn bright on one side by a rope long gone.
ambient: Gulls wheel overhead and will not follow you in.

descriptions: A low dome of wet rock. Water beads on every surface and falls in slow, ringing drops.
A grotto lit by a faint green glow from algae on the ceiling.
features: A ring of pebbles, carefully arranged, around nothing at all.
ambient: A drop of water lands on your neck.

descriptions: A still pool fills most of the chamber, its surface flat as glass.
The floor dips into a pool that rises and falls with a tide you cannot hear.
features: Pale anemones close as your shadow passes over them.
ambient: The pool shivers, though nothing touched it.

descriptions: A winding passage, scoured smooth by water. You walk bent to keep your head clear.
A crack in the rock just wide enough to pass, its walls slick with weed.
ambient: Your footsteps come back to you a moment late.

descriptions: Dried kelp hangs from the ceiling in long curtains that rustle as you pass.
A tall chamber festooned with kelp, as if the sea once filled it to the roof.
features: Something has knotted the kelp into crude, careful shapes.
ambient: The kelp stirs in a draught you cannot feel.

descriptions: A ledge heaped with the bones of fish and seabirds, picked clean.
Small bones crunch underfoot. Something feeds here, and is tidy about it.
features: A gull skull, polished, set apart from the rest.

descriptions: A natural alcove someone has made holy: shells pressed into the walls in spirals.
A small, dry chamber with a flat stone like an altar at its centre.
features: Offerings of sea-glass, sorted by colour.
A rune scratched into the stone, worn almost smooth.

descriptions: The floor slopes down to black water. The air is thick and still.
A chamber where seawater collects and slowly sours.
ambient: A bubble rises from the black water and breaks.

descriptions: A long gallery with pillars of dripstone, like the nave of a drowned church.
A high, narrow gallery. Light from somewhere far above falls in a single thread.
features: Tide-lines on the pillars, far above your head.
